title: Easy Street Dance Steps Tutorial | Funky Moves

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher is energetic and enthusiastic, encouraging family participation with friendly, upbeat instructions. She breaks down movements into simple steps and demonstrates them at a steady pace before combining them with music.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to Funky Moves family dance vlog
Breakdown of the Funky Bounce step
Breakdown of the Criss Cross step
Breakdown of the Funky Scoop step
Breakdown of the Electricity Wave step
Practicing all steps together to music

metaphors: Electricity running through your arm and body
common_mistakes: Not going low then high on the bounce
Standing too straight on the wave arm movement

steps_taught.name: The Funky Bounce
steps_taught.description: Hands on right knee bouncing up and down twice, then repeat on left

steps_taught.name: The Criss Cross
steps_taught.description: Jump feet cross in middle with right in front, then jump out to the side

steps_taught.name: The Funky Scoop
steps_taught.description: Scoop low to the side and bring it into the chest, alternating sides

steps_taught.name: The Electricity Wave
steps_taught.description: Wave arms through wrist, elbow, shoulder, body, and flick out

quotes.text: We are keeping it super simple with our Funky Moves basic dance steps.
We have got our four dance steps to learn today.
Let's do all four dance steps two times ending in a super cool funky pose.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates hand placement on knee with alternating knee bounces
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact weight distribution on back foot

evidence_segments.observation: Jumping with crossed legs and uncrossing to wide stance

extraction.distinctive_method: Framing the tutorial as a family dance vlog inviting parents and kids to join in together.
